messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Excess swag redistribution & hotel staging for StorageCon — jackets + chargers

Team,

Quick summary from the StorageCon teardown: we have an overage at the venue — roughly 320 jackets (various sizes, see manifest attached) and ~200 wireless chargers left on the loading dock. A few jackets (about 12) were flagged for minor logo misalignment during onsite QA (photos attached).

Problem: our vendor (MerchPros) needs items returned or evidence of rework to issue any credit. Freight windows for returns this calendar quarter are tight, and international customs paperwork might be needed for the chargers (FCC paperwork).

Proposal: stage the excess at the Hilton (Ben Rogers is copied on this thread) in their event storage area for up to 7 calendar days. Atlas Logistics can do a consolidated pickup from the hotel if we palletize and label. Meanwhile, Marissa — can you run a 30-sample QA (pick sizes: S/M/L/XL) and confirm which jackets are rework vs return? Diego/Logan — please confirm whether we want to: 1) return to vendor for credit, 2) send to the SF user workshop on Nov 10, or 3) donate the remainder.

Attachments: packing_manifest_StorageCon_20261028.csv, photo_jacket_logo_1012.jpg

I need narrow answers by EOD tomorrow so we can confirm staging with Hilton and lock Atlas pickup slots.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Field Marketing Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Kate Miller <kate@merchpros.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Excess swag redistribution & hotel staging for StorageCon — jackets + chargers

Vivek — thanks for the heads up and the manifest. We reviewed your SKU list. Short answers first: we can accept returns and issue credit for items returned in resalable condition, or we can perform a rework service (we can replace printed panels for misaligned logos) and ship back at a reduced fee.

Notes:
- We will issue credit for up to 120 jackets if returned intact and palletized (we need the packing_manifest and photos; manifest looks fine).
- Rework: we can pick up the 12 flagged jackets and return them within 7 business days after repair; lead time depends on embroidery vs print.
- Chargers: we cannot accept chargers back without FCC/CMI declarations — please provide certificates or we will refuse and advise a third-party electronics recycler.

If you choose staging at the Hilton, please provide a pick window (date + 4-hour block) and Atlas should present a bill of lading referencing our RMA number (we will provide once we confirm return quantity).

I can get you a preliminary credit estimate once you confirm the quantities you intend to return vs redeploy.

Best,
Kate Miller
Vendor Relations Manager
MerchPros LLC

- Available staging window: Nov 1–Nov 7, pickup any day during that window.
- Access: driver check-in at 07:00–18:00; Atlas drivers will need to be pre-registered and present ID.
- Max pallet height: 5ft; we have a 10x12 staging bay.

I've attached the hotel_staging_map.pdf with the dock instructions and contact number. Please confirm the number of pallets and arrival window so we can reserve the bay.

Regards,

Subject: Re: Excess swag redistribution & hotel staging for StorageCon — jackets + chargers

Vivek / team — Atlas can pick up from Hilton Room B12. A couple operational notes and rate estimates:

- Requirements: items palletized, shrink-wrapped, and labeled with SKU + quantity. We require a manifest and PO or RMA to accept the load.
- Customs: if chargers are included and destined outside the US, we need FCC/CE paperwork and the HS codes; otherwise we will process as domestic return/recycle.
- Rates (estimate): local transfer + pallet handling $225/pallet; consolidation to our SF yard and LTL to vendor or warehouse TBD after we know final pallet count.
- Earliest available pickup slot from Hilton: Nov 3 (08:00–12:00). Please confirm by Nov 1 COB so we can allocate a truck.

PO/reference for booking: please include HS-4321 in BOL.

Ops contact: Sofia (driver coordinator) +1-415-555-0789

Thanks,
Atlas Logistics Operations

Subject: Re: Excess swag redistribution & hotel staging for StorageCon — jackets + chargers

All — finalizing plan and action items below (confirmed with vendor + hotel + Atlas):

Decision:
- Return 120 jackets to MerchPros for credit.
- Rework 12 flagged jackets (MerchPros will collect separately).
- Redeploy remaining jackets (~188) to SF workshop on Nov 10.
- Chargers (200): segregate into compliance vs non-compliant. Non-compliant chargers will be recycled unless we get FCC certs by Nov 4.

Operational items (owners & deadlines):
- Packing & palletization (Diego): prepare pallets at Hilton B12 on Nov 2 evening; target 6 pallets max (estimate). Attach manifest to BOL.
- QA sample (Marissa): I will perform a 30-sample check tonight and upload photos to the Drive folder. Criteria: seam check, logo alignment, zipper function. Expected result: 12 fail -> assigned to rework.
- Vendor credit (Vivek/Kate): Vivek, please approve the 120-unit return list so Kate can issue RMA and preliminary credit estimate. (Due Nov 2 morning)
- Atlas booking (Logan): confirm Nov 3 pickup 08:00–12:00 with Sofia and include HS-4321 on BOL (Due Nov 1 COB)
- Hotel staging confirmation (Vivek): confirm staging window Nov 1–7 with Ben.

Attachments: packing_manifest_StorageCon_20261028.csv, photo_jacket_logo_1012.jpg, hotel_staging_map.pdf

Thanks everyone — if we stick to the timelines above we should close the vendor credit and redeploy inventory before the Nov 10 workshop. I’ll upload the QA photos and final manifest to the Drive link (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMERCH).

Marissa Cole
Event Logistics Manager
Redwood Inference
